# omp packages

> A catalog of plugins for oh-my-pi (omp), and a record of which pi packages work on omp. Data comes from the npm registry and from user reports.

Every package page answers one question: does this package work on omp? Each one has one of four statuses:

- Built for omp: the author tagged the package with an omp keyword.
- Works on omp: users reported that it works, and no more users reported it broken.
- Broken on omp: more users reported it broken than working.
- Untested on omp: a pi package with no reports yet.

Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page below to get Markdown instead of HTML.

## Pages

- [All packages](https://omppackages.com/): sorted by monthly downloads, 50 per page; add `?page=N`.
- [Built for omp](https://omppackages.com/?status=native)
- [Works on omp](https://omppackages.com/?status=works)
- [Broken on omp](https://omppackages.com/?status=broken)
- [Untested on omp](https://omppackages.com/?status=untested)
- Package page: `https://omppackages.com/packages/<npm-name>`, with status, report notes, install command, and README.
- Status badge: `https://omppackages.com/badge/<npm-name>.svg`
- Search: `https://omppackages.com/search?q=<text>` matches name and description (at least 3 characters).
- [Get listed](https://omppackages.com/get-listed): how to publish a package so it appears here.
- [About](https://omppackages.com/about): data sources and how a status is decided.
- [Sitemap](https://omppackages.com/sitemap.xml): every package URL.

## Install a package

`omp plugin install <npm-name>`
